blocks.text: Julia Montes admitted that taking on business responsibilities alongside her acting career has been challenging, as she continues to find her footing as an executive producer of the TV series “Sigabo” and CEO of health and wellness brand. During the launch of her brand’s new supplement, Montes opened up to the media about her work as an executive TV producer, revealing that it was her partner, Coco Martin, who encouraged her to embrace the role. “Nahihiya nga ako na tawagin ng ganun,” she said. “Sinurpresa niya ako dun sa OBB ng ‘Batang Quiapo’… pinakita niya ‘yung pangalan ko.” “Sabi niya sa […]...
